Configuration Drift and Compliance Bypass [Repudiation, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-732] on AWS Config, CloudWatch, IAM Roles, Security Groups: Attackers might attempt to modify or disable AWS Config rules, or exploit gaps in configuration monitoring to make unauthorized changes without detection. An attacker modifies security group rules or IAM policies while simultaneously disabling or bypassing Config rules that would detect such changes.

Denial of Service Through Load Balancer Exploitation [Denial of Service, CWE-400] on Application Load Balancers, Route 53, AWS Shield: Attackers might attempt to overwhelm ALBs with traffic, potentially bypassing AWS Shield Standard protection and affecting application availability. Unauthorized Data Access Through IAM Misconfiguration [Spoofing, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-284] on IAM Roles, Lambda Functions, DynamoDB Tables, Aurora Databases: Overly permissive IAM roles or misconfigured policies could allow unauthorized access to data or resources across regions.
